submitted.rationale: I measured EQE at 5 compositions on the line, from Sb 0.15 to 0.66. EQE rose steeply toward the Pb-rich end. Sb 0.195 (index 1) gave the highest value, 0.0215%, higher than Sb 0.15 (0.0144%) and Sb 0.32 (0.0098%), so the peak probably sits near Sb ≈ 0.2. The Sb-rich compositions near the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore (Sb 0.5) and PbSb2O6 (Sb 0.67) were weak under 2.1 eV illumination. No XRD was measured.

rejected.reason: Sb 0.50 (near pyrochlore): EQE 0.00093%, about 20 times lower than index 1
Sb 0.66 (near PbSb2O6): EQE 0.00045%, the lowest measured
